arStrings.szText: While {c_important}{u}Healthy{/u}{/c}, the explosion of {c_important}Frozen Orb{/c} deals {c_number}[{SF_27}  * 100|%x|]{/c} increased damage.

When {c_important}Frozen Orb{/c} first explodes it remains stationary for {c_number}[SF_46|1|]{/c} seconds then seeks another target to explode again, dealing {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEA_2ND_IMPACT_DAMAGE}{/c} damage.

{c_important}{u}Ice Spikes{/u}{/c} spawn around {c_important}Frozen Orb{/c}, dealing {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEB_TOOLTIP}{/c} damage.

{c_important}Frozen Orb{/c} makes enemies {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} for {c_number}{SF_51}{/c} seconds.

{c_important}Frozen Orb{/c} becomes a {c_important}Pyromancy{/c} Skill that deals {c_number}{dot:BURNING}{/c} Burning damage over {c_number}[SF_42]{/c} seconds and explodes for {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEC_IMPACT_DAMAGE}{/c} Fire damage

{c_important}Frozen Orb{/c} will explode up to {c_number}[SF_59]{/c} times along its path, consuming {c_number}[SF_36]{/c} |4stack:stacks; of {c_important}{u}Overpower{/u}{/c} each time.

{c_important}Frozen Orb{/c} grants a {c_important}{u}Barrier{/u}{/c} for {c_number}[{SF_20}*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([PlayerHealthMax() * SF_20]){/c} for {c_number}{buffduration:BARRIER}{/c} seconds for each enemy hit by its explosion, up to {c_number}[{SF_23} * 100|%|]{/c}.
{c_important}Frozen Orb{/c} lasts {c_number}[SF_61]{/c} additional second before exploding.
